evidence: https://www.dadecountymo.gov/assessor (links to Dade County Public GIS viewer at dadegis.integritygis.com, the viewer for the token-protected assessor data)
note: Dade County MO parcel polygons are served by the county's integritygis assessor MapServer (Dade_Assessor_Data, Parcel / Parcel Public layers), but that service requires a token. No public, token-free parcel service or file was found; the other sources are commercial vendors (Dynamo Spatial, Regrid, Rockford Map).
